title: Skip Lids & Doors
description: Plastic lids and overlapping doors for skips and enclosed containers.

products.name: 1100L Trade Waste Lid - 1237mm x 977mm (Saracen Lid)
description: Upgrade your waste management system with the 1100L Trade Waste Lid. This 1237mm x 977mm lid comes equipped with handle slots for easy operation and patented CCE lock for added security. Its extra strong hinges and nestable design make it a cost-effective and efficient solution. Plus, the prop sockets located at the rear allow for easy propping open.
To fit 1100 ltr Tradewaste containers. Suitable for roll-top conversion.

products.name: SKIP Lid Slave - 835mm x 1604mm
description: The Skip Lid Slave is a versatile solution for bulk waste transport. Its overlapping pair prevents water ingress, while the moulded-in handles and 3 hinge lugs per lid ensure optimal strength. Personalize with a custom name plate and easily open and close by hand or with a spring system. Save on freight costs with its nestable design.
Overlapping and watertight pair of lids for use on symmetrical skips.

products.name: Overlapping Doors - 930mm x 652mm
description: Increase the functionality and security of your containers and skips with our Overlapping Doors. These doors prevent water ingress with their overlapping design, while also featuring 2 mould-in handle slots for easy operation. Personalize with a custom name plate and secure with our patented CCE lock. Plus, with 4 ribs per lid, you can trust in their strength.
Normally used as a pair of overlapping doors.
